title: mxv/sweep/v1
description: Each live workspace that the run considered, whether it archived the workspace, would archive it on a dry run, or kept it for the reason that the row gives, and the bytes that each archive freed.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

SweepRow.description: One workspace, as `mxv sweep` prints it.

state.description:
`archived` when the run archived the workspace, `would_archive` on
a dry run, or `kept`.

freed.description:
The bytes that the workspace's directory took before the archive
deleted it, or take on a dry run, and 0 for a workspace that the run
kept. The archive keeps the ignored files of its checkouts in a tar
outside the directory, so the disk frees a little less.

reason.description: Why the run kept the workspace, or null.

board_mounts.description:
Each board mount whose update the run ran, such as
`/repos/multiverse in /Users/you/board`.

mount_failures.description:
Each board mount update that failed, with the command that runs it
again.

SweepState.description: What `mxv sweep` does with one workspace.

oneOf.description: A dry run would archive the workspace.
The run keeps the workspace, for the reason that the row gives.
